annotation.title_clean: Inter-American Framework on Data Governance and Artificial Intelligence (MIGDIA)
annotation.title_en: Inter-American Framework on Data Governance and Artificial Intelligence (MIGDIA)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Organization of American States (OAS), Department for Effective Public Management
annotation.summary_en: OAS web page describing MIGDIA, a regional framework to guide member states in data governance for AI, comprising 104 guidelines in 12 thematic areas, a regional study and a model policy, co-created via working groups and public consultation. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: MIGDIA offers guidelines in 12 thematic areas as a roadmap for national data and AI governance
Includes a study on the state of data and AI governance in the Americas
Includes a model data and AI governance policy (draft) as a reference
Developed via co-creation with government, civil society and private sector working groups plus public consultation
Technical assistance provided to Brazil and Argentina on data governance policy
